meta.title: Reject a bid without allowing the seller to bid again
warnings: dropped place_bid — the case switches to the vendor's side to look, and never says the vendor bids
dropped place_bid — the case switches to the vendor's side to look, and never says the vendor bids

steps.note: Create the auction event used by this test.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event with an auction stage.
Move to the auction stage before configuring it.
Apply the auction pricing template.
Add one auction line item.
Complete the auction pricing sheet.
Commit a live bidding schedule.
Invite one vendor who can submit the bid.
Publish the auction.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted before rejection.
Return to the buyer console for the rejection workflow.
Open the auction Responses tab where the vendor bid is shown.

args.goal: open the three-dot menu next to the vendor's bid, choose Reject Bid, leave the allow-to-bid-again checkbox unchecked, confirm the rejection, and stop when the rejection is visibly completed

steps.note: Perform the rejection flow and explicitly leave rebidding disabled.
Open the comparison grid to verify the rejected bid is gone.
Assert that no vendor bid column remains in QCS.
Return to the vendor session to test whether rebidding is blocked.
Open the rejected auction in the vendor portal.
Attempt a new quote and require Procol to refuse it because rebidding was disabled.
